title: Learning Generated Controls under Fractured Geometry: Projective Residualization and Variation-Allocation Frontiers
abstract: arXiv:2606.14636v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many two-stage estimators assess the first-stage learner by prediction error, even when the next stage uses its residual. In control-function instrumental variables, that residual must preserve the latent control direction without removing the treatment variation that identifies the structural response. A scalar prediction score does not reveal how the learner allocates this variation. Under piecewise-smooth graph geometry, interpolation can suppress the control, whereas isotropic smoothing can leak systematic variation across boundaries. We formulate this as a variation-allocation problem and introduce Adaptive Anisotropic Instrumental Heat Flow (A-IHF). The method uses pilot treatment contrasts to adapt edge conductance, takes the complement of a sparse graph resolvent as the generated control, and selects candidates without consulting outcomes. translated_title: 破碎几何下的生成控制变量学习：投影残差化与变化分配前沿
translated_abstract: 许多两阶段估计器通过预测误差来评估第一阶段学习器，即使下一阶段使用的是其残差。在控制函数工具变量方法中，该残差必须保留潜在的控制方向，同时不消除用于识别结构性响应的处理变化。标量预测分数无法揭示学习器如何分配这种变化。在分段平滑的图几何结构下，插值可能抑制控制变量，而各向同性平滑则可能使系统性变化跨边界泄漏。我们将此表述为一个变化分配问题，并提出了自适应各向异性工具热流。该方法使用先导处理对比来自适应调整边电导，将稀疏图预解式的补作为生成控制变量，并在不参考结果的情况下选择候选。对于线性控制函数回归，生成控制变量仅由（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出自适应各向异性工具热流方法，通过投影残差化与变化分配框架，在分段平滑图几何下构建能保留潜在控制方向且防止系统性处理变化跨边界泄漏的生成控制变量，从而改进控制函数工具变量估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Adaptive Anisotropic Instrumental Heat Flow (A-IHF), which constructs generated controls via projective residualization and a variation-allocation framework on piecewise-smooth graph geometry, preserving latent control directions while preventing systematic treatment variation from leaking across boundaries in control-function instrumental variable estimation.
